english.title: Personal licence holder charged with offence fail produce licence at next court appearance - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been charged with a relevant offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFENCE..), and being the holder of a personal licence granted subsequent to your first appearance before **(..SPECIFY THE MAGISTRATES' COURT..) in connection with that offence, failed without reasonable excuse to produce your licence to the court at your next appearance or notify the court of the existence of such a licence, the identity of the relevant authority and the reasons why you could not produce it
english.legislation: Contrary to section 128(6) and (7) of the Licensing Act 2003.
